mapper.select: SELECT keycode, ggubun, mgubun, orderym FROM (SELECT keycode, ggubun, mgubun, orderym, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ggubun, ISNULL(NULLIF(RTRIM(mgubun), ''), SUBSTRING(keycode, 3, 2)) ORDER BY idate DESC, keycode DESC ) AS rn FROM hohosc_TableBookLabel WHERE RTRIM(preschool_code) = #{preschoolCode} AND orderym = #{orderym} AND keycode IS NOT NULL AND ggubun IS NOT NULL) A WHERE rn = 1
